about: WHAT IS IN THE GAME FOR NOW, AND WHAT IS HELD BACK (Code/Game/Content/ContentHold.cs; the user, 9 Oct 2026: "for now we don't include any fully fleshed out quests/ cards until they're polished, only keep in the good polished stuff for now and we will add in the other content when it's all done"). NOTHING IS DELETED. A card file of Game/Data/encounters that is not named under 'in' is not read into the game: its quests and cards never come up. TO LET A FILE IN when it is polished, add its name under 'in' with "all"; or with a list of the ids of its cards that are polished, and the rest of that file stays held. A new card file is held until it is named here. "hold": false lets everything in, as it was before. The tests go on reading every card file off the disk, so what is held is still checked while it waits.
the_cut: The user's, by the picker, 9 Oct 2026: 'Sea cards back in'. In: the toll, the lender, and the 63 everyday cards at sea (my drafts, not yet polished by the user). Held: all 43 quests, the ports' own cards, the dated cards, and the crew's 112.

why_these.harbour_793.json: the toll at a Frankish port (1 card): the toll is a rule of the game, and this card is how it is asked and paid
why_these.wokerer_793.json: the lender (8 cards): the debt is the first life's goal; these are his reminders, his day and the clean stick
why_these.sea_793.json: what happens at sea (63 cards): calms, swell and gales, squalls, fog, wrecks, whales and birds, ice, sickness and thirst, a quarrel at the oars. Four of them the boat herself raises (Voyage/BoatWatch.cs): the swell before a gale, the gale, the leak that gains, the sail that splits

held_on_9_oct_2026.the ports' cards: baltic_east, danes_norway, england_south_east, neustria_west, northumbria_irish_sea, rhine_frisia, rhineland_flanders: 548 cards
